title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - Resource
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/Resource. Useful substances and objects. Subclass of geo:Feature and saref:FeatureOfInterest (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.1.1.11); base class for s4envi:Waste, s4envi:PrimaryRawResource and s4envi:SecondaryRawResource, whose own models document only their own additional attributes and do not repeat location.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Resource'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

location.description: GeoProperty. Geolocation of the resource, expressed as a GeoJSON Point.
